title: useStore
subtitle: React hook for @qortex/store
description: Subscribe to a store from React components with selector and equality support.
content: The `useStore` hook provides concurrent-mode safe subscriptions to your store. It re-renders the component only when the selected value changes.

signature.code:
useStore<T, U = T>(
  store: Store<T>,
  selector?: (state: T) => U,
  equalityFn?: (a: U, b: U) => boolean,
): U

behaviors.label: Concurrent-mode safe — fully compatible with React 18+ features
Without a selector, the full state is returned and the component re-renders on every change
